-- Generated by ekos-lakehouse (RFC 0195) from marts/orders_per_customer.md. Approve by merging; do not edit.
{{ config(materialized='table', schema='gold', alias='orders_per_customer') }}

select
    date_trunc('month', "C_ORDER"."CREATED") as "month",
    "C_BPARTNER"."NAME" as "customer",
    count(*) as "count_of_c_order_id"
from {{ ref('ADEMPIERE__C_ORDER') }} as "C_ORDER"
left join {{ ref('ADEMPIERE__C_BPARTNER') }} as "C_BPARTNER"
    on "C_ORDER"."C_BPARTNER_ID" = "C_BPARTNER"."C_BPARTNER_ID"
where "C_ORDER"."ISACTIVE" = true
    and "C_ORDER"."DOCSTATUS" = 'CO'
group by date_trunc('month', "C_ORDER"."CREATED"), "C_BPARTNER"."NAME"
description:
---
mart: orders_per_customer
grain:
- month
- customer
dimensions:
  month: month of C_ORDER.CREATED
  customer: c_bpartner.name via c_order.c_bpartner_id
measures:
  count_of_c_order_id: count of c_order
filters:
- C_ORDER.ISACTIVE = true
- c_order.docstatus = 'CO'
---

number of completed sales orders per customer and month
